meta.name: miniprogram-development
meta.description: WeChat Mini Program development skill for building, debugging, previewing, testing, publishing, and optimizing mini program projects. This skill should be used when users ask to create, develop, modify, debug, preview, test, deploy, publish, launch, review, or optimize WeChat Mini Programs, mini program pages, components, `tabBar`, routing, navigation, icon assets, project structure, project configuration, `project.config.json`, `appid` setup, device preview, real-device validation, WeChat Developer Tools Nightly workflows, `wechatide` CLI, WeChat IDE Skills/MCP, console/network debugging, `miniprogram-ci` preview/upload flows, or mini program release processes. It should also be used when users explicitly mention CloudBase, `wx.cloud`, Tencent CloudBase, 腾讯云开发, 微信云开发, or 云开发 in a mini program project.

copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are developing or maintaining a WeChat Mini Program project

howto.what: 安装后，Claude会遵循微信小程序开发规范，帮助创建、修改、调试、预览和发布项目。在修改代码或上传前，Claude会先执行变更安全协议和部署网关检查。支持CloudBase云开发集成。
howto.when: 当你提出关于微信小程序的创建、开发、修改、调试、预览、测试、部署、发布等操作请求，或明确提到CloudBase、wx.cloud等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我创建一个微信小程序项目，包含首页和我的页面。
say.note: Claude会生成项目骨架和页面文件。

say.text: 调试当前小程序，打开开发者工具。

say.note: Claude会先检查部署网关再执行发布。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude follows WeChat Mini Program development conventions, helping create, modify, debug, preview, and publish projects. Before code changes or uploads, Claude executes change safety and deployment gate checks. Supports CloudBase integration.
howto.when_en: Triggered when users request to create, develop, modify, debug, preview, test, deploy, publish, or optimize WeChat Mini Programs, or when CloudBase, wx.cloud, or related terms are mentioned.

say_en.text: Create a WeChat Mini Program project with pages for home and profile.
say_en.note: Claude will generate project skeleton and page files.

say_en.text: Debug the mini program using Developer Tools.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through Nightly DevTools debug workflow.

say_en.text: Publish the mini program to WeChat.
say_en.note: Claude will first run deployment gate checks before publishing.
